exposure: IUD (Intrauterine Device use, likely a typo for IUFD - Intrauterine Fetal Demise given context, but abstract says IUD)
cohort: The study included 212 women recruited from Ganesh Shanker Vidyarthi Medical College in Kanpur city, Uttar Pradesh, India.
finding: The study found a high prevalence of severe anaemia (21.2%) and various maternal complications such as APH (12.7%), ante-partum eclampsia (9.9%), PET (7.5%), and NSPET (4.7%) among the participants.
mod_finding: The study collected data on mode of delivery (normal, caesarean, and stillbirth) but did not present specific findings or associations related to it in the abstract.
